# Contra

> > Contra is a commission-free freelance platform connecting clients with independent professionals across design, development, marketing, and creative services worldwide.

Contra enables businesses to discover and hire freelancers specializing in web development, UX design, social media marketing, content creation, and emerging technologies like AR/VR. The platform serves a global marketplace with talent across major cities including New York, California, Berlin, São Paulo, and Gujarat, supporting multiple languages and skill sets from Shopify development to motion design.

## Key Topics

- Commission-free freelance platform
- Freelancer marketplace
- Project management
- Portfolio review
- Web development (Shopify, Framer, Frontend)
- UX/UI Design (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD)
- Social media marketing
- Brand design
- Content creation
- AR/VR development
- Client communication
- Hiring guides
- Global talent (New York, California, Berlin, São Paulo, England)
- Mobile development (Android)
- Video production and motion design
